brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on induction-wad caps (market headroom at volume) and qualify Manjushree as second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volumes
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict says 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — our volume and flexibility justify the lower band

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj publishes no financials, so we have no view on their health, size, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹58.17 L annual spend is material, but we don't know their total revenue to judge how big a customer we are. That means our leverage comes from the market: the ask-price data shows room to move, and we have five strong alternate suppliers ready to qualify. Without their numbers, we lean on competitive pressure and our own data, not their balance sheet.

evidence.point: Market asking price band for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; health score B (65/100), revenue ₹2569.83 Cr — the top second-source candidate to qualify now

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable — robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed supplier with broad moulded and blow-moulded packaging capability across bottles and caps

risks: Suraj's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their stability — qualify Manjushree fast in case Suraj stumbles
Without knowing their revenue, we can't gauge how hard to push — err on the side of data (market ask) rather than guessing their margin
Pushing too hard on price when we don't know their cost base could backfire if they're already thin — watch for pushback and be ready to split the gap
Five alternates and six market backup leads look strong on paper, but none are qualified yet — start RFQs now so we have real options by next quarter
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about moving our cap prices toward ₹0.65–0.80 per piece at our volumes — the market shows headroom there — and we're also qualifying a second source to de-risk our supply, so let's find a deal that keeps you our lead supplier.
